Legal entity, attendance, social counts and a CEO title not found; Dean Spanos is chairman, A.G. Spanos and John Spanos are presidents of business and football operations.

ownership_summary: The Spanos family has controlled the Chargers since Alex and Faye Spanos bought the team in 1984; Dean Spanos and siblings Michael and Alexis hold 61%. Pistons owner Tom Gores (with Holly Gores) bought 27% in 2024, private equity firm Arctos Partners bought 8% in May 2025, and two long-time limited partners hold the other 4%.
